text:
𝗪𝗢𝗪 𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗗𝗔𝗕! 🇵🇰

Shadab 113* (96) and a record 89* last-wicket stand with Rauf beat England by 1 wicket in Lahore.

Chased 242, won with 243/9 🔥

#Cricket #PAKvENG

facebook.caption:
𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗗𝗔𝗕 𝗞𝗔 𝗠𝗔𝗦𝗦𝗜𝗩𝗘 𝗖𝗛𝗔𝗦𝗘! 🇵🇰🔥

👉 Pakistan ne England ko Lahore mein 1 wicket se haraya
👉 Shadab Khan: 113* (96 balls), pehla ODI shatak
👉 Haris Rauf ke saath 89* ki record last-wicket partnership
👉 Pakistan 103/5 aur 154/9 par the, phir bhi 243/9 banaya

Is se behtar chase dekha hai? Comment karo 👇
